CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Leisure? (1 mark)
   A. Use Leisure to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Leisure with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leisure.
   D. Say Leisure has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inspired Word of God.
   B. Say Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Temptations of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Temptations of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Temptations of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Temptations of Jesus Christ.
   D. Say The Temptations of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Miracle of Healing? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracle of Healing.
   B. Say Miracle of Healing has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Miracle of Healing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Miracle of Healing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Ten Commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Ten Commandments with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Ten Commandments.
   C. Say The Ten Commandments has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Ten Commandments to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Jacob Wrestles an Angel? (1 mark)
   A. Use Jacob Wrestles an Angel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jacob Wrestles an Angel.
   C. Say Jacob Wrestles an Angel has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jacob Wrestles an Angel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Call of Disciples? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Call of Disciples with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Call of Disciples.
   C. Use The Call of Disciples to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Call of Disciples has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Jesus Christ.
   B. Say Miracles of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Miracles of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of My Purpose? (1 mark)
   A. Say My Purpose has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of My Purpose with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Purpose.
   D. Use My Purpose to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Marriage and Family? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Marriage and Family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Marriage and Family has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Marriage and Family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Marriage and Family.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines.
   D. Say Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines has no place in daily life.

14. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

15. Which response best shows understanding of Faith in God Elisha? (1 mark)
   A. Use Faith in God Elisha to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith in God Elisha.
   C. Say Faith in God Elisha has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Faith in God Elisha with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Miracle of Healing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Lazarus is raised from Dead 4 3.6 The Hidden Treasure 5 3.7 The Rich Man and Laz and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Raising Lazarus from the Dead and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain The Hidden Treasure 5 3.7 The Rich Man and Lazarus 4 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Apos and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain The Hidden Treasure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain The Rich man and Lazarus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain The Apostles’ Creed 4 4.2 Standing Firm in Faith 4 Page 13 of 69 xiii 4.3 Church and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Apostles’ Creed and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
